purpose: Prospectively test whether an explicit frozen local generative support verifier repairs answer/no-answer abstention on a previously unused adversarial source, and whether the frozen v49 low-core FRC selector adds evidence utility beyond non-FRC and FRC controls under that identical verifier decision.

prior_result_boundary.allowed_aggregate_motivation_only: v57 showed that relevance and document-identity gates did not reliably distinguish whether a relevant paragraph actually supported an answer; no v57 case was inspected or transferred.

theoretical_mechanism.name: shared_paragraph_support_verifier_plus_transferred_low_core_frc_v58
theoretical_mechanism.support_decision: A frozen local instruction model sees only the question and its provided paragraph, then returns exactly SUPPORTED when the paragraph explicitly contains enough information to answer, otherwise UNSUPPORTED.
theoretical_mechanism.shared_gate: The one case-level support decision is reused unchanged across every token budget and every gated selector, preventing method-specific prompts or verifier calls from confounding selector comparisons.
theoretical_mechanism.candidate_selector: Reuse low_core_divergence_guarded_frc_v49 exactly, with no v58 parameter, cutoff or source-specific adjustment.
theoretical_mechanism.fail_closed_rule: Any output other than an exact case-insensitive SUPPORTED or UNSUPPORTED token is recorded as malformed and mapped to UNSUPPORTED; any malformed output fails the registered development gate.
theoretical_mechanism.rationale: Answerability is a semantic support property rather than a relevance rank property. A shared verifier can supply the missing abstention signal, while the transferred selector comparison tests whether FRC still contributes after that signal is held constant.

source.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as stated on the official SQuAD homepage
source.known_public_structure: data -> article(title, paragraphs) -> paragraph(context, qas) -> question(id, question, is_impossible, answers, plausible_answers)
source.published_scale: SQuAD 2.0 combines the SQuAD 1.1 questions with more than 50,000 adversarial unanswerable questions that resemble answerable questions.

access_order: Freeze this protocol, the source-independent implementation, the exact support prompt and synthetic invariants before downloading either source file.
Download train and dev as opaque bytes, record size and SHA-256, and register both without parsing JSON content.
Freeze protocol, source, module, runner and test hashes before opening train for development preparation.
Parse train only, construct blind retrieval and verifier-input caches, and keep dev unopened.
Register blind-cache hashes, local model hashes and CUDA runtime before deterministic query generation, BGE scoring or Qwen inference.
Complete every BGE score and Qwen support-decision row before joining is_impossible, answers or gold evidence intervals.
Run the registered development gates exactly once. Parse dev exactly once only if every development gate passes; otherwise publish a closure and stop.
Never reuse revealed development cases for formula, prompt, threshold, budget, sample, model or method selection.

task_construction.case: Each SQuAD 2.0 QA object with a non-empty unique id and question in a non-empty paragraph.
task_construction.answer_bearing: is_impossible is false and every retained answer has a valid exact character interval in the paragraph.
task_construction.no_answer: is_impossible is true; plausible_answers are never exposed to preparation, scoring, prompting or evaluation.
task_construction.gold_evidence: For answer-bearing cases, the union of deterministic paragraph units overlapping any official answer interval; no official answer-string EM or F1 is claimed.
task_construction.verifier_input: The complete provided paragraph and current question only, with raw ids, article title, is_impossible, answers and plausible_answers excluded.
task_construction.candidate_units: Deterministic sentence spans, with overlong spans split into offset-preserving windows.
task_construction.schema_exclusion: Missing or malformed article, paragraph, QA, id, question, context, impossible flag, answer list or exact answer interval; rate above 0.01 fails development.

blind_retrieval_and_models.retrieval_pool: Every deterministic unit from the provided paragraph; no external document or decoy is added.

frozen_atomic_queries.direct_answer: Find the sentence that directly contains the answer to this question: {question}
frozen_atomic_queries.context_bridge: Find context, definitions, entities, or relations needed to resolve this question: {question}
frozen_atomic_queries.counterevidence: Find negations, missing assumptions, contrasts, qualifications, dates, or limitations relevant to this question: {question}

methods.shared_gate_non_frc: The five frozen v49 non-FRC selectors, each preceded by the identical case-level Qwen support decision.
methods.shared_gate_frc_controls: Every frozen v49 FRC control except low_core_divergence_guarded_frc_v49, each preceded by the identical case-level Qwen support decision.
methods.ungated_controls: All frozen v49 methods with no support verifier.

evaluation.answer_metric: Exact deterministic evidence-unit set F1 against the union of official answer-overlap units.
evaluation.verifier_metric: Balanced accuracy across answer-bearing pass and no-answer rejection, plus each component separately.

scope_limits: English closed-paragraph SQuAD 2.0 evidence-unit selection and support verification on balanced public samples; not official answer-string evaluation, hidden-test submission, open-corpus retrieval, SetR reproduction, flood-domain validation, selector adoption or rollout authorization.
